input: Yao et al. (2023) evaluate ReAct on ALFWorld and WebShop with one- or two-shot prompts. ReAct beats Act and imitation-learning baselines trained on thousands of trajectories, but its WebShop success rate (40%) remains well below human experts (59.6%). Critique a claim that ReAct reaches human-level decision making with prompting alone.
source: Yao et al. 2023, Section 4 Decision Making Tasks, Tables 3-4 (chunks yao2023-021 to yao2023-024)
